ऐसे अनुबंध में ठेकेदार को दोगुनी मजदूरी देनी होती है, लेकिन श्रमिक अप्रत्यक्ष ठेका श्रमिक ही रहते हैं

questions.question_english:
Which of these statements best describes
the legal framework surrounding the ‘Sham and
Bogus’ contract labour system?
options_english:
It is fully permitted under the provisions
of the Contract Labour (Regulation and
Abolition) Act, 1970 as a legitimate business
model to optimize administrative operational
costs.

Statutory Labour Courts and Industrial
Tribunals possess zero legal jurisdiction to
pierce the corporate veil of a contract.

The contractor must pay double wages in a
sham contract, but workers remain legally
classified as indirect contract labour.

If a contract is sham and bogus, workers are
deemed direct employees of the principal
employer.
questions.explanation_english:
If a contract is sham and bogus, workers
are deemed direct employees of the principal
employer.
Judgments like SAIL establish that where a
contract system is a sham or camouflage to
disguise direct employment, the intermediary
contractor is ignored and workers are legally
recognized as direct employees of the Principal
Employer.
questions.explanation_hindi: छद्म या दिखावटी ठेका व्यवस्था पाए जाने पर श्रमिकों को प्रधान नियोक्ता का प्रत्यक्ष कर्मचारी माना जा सकता है।
key_facts:
Correct option (English): If a contract is sham and bogus, workers are
deemed direct employees of the principal
employer.

questions.question_english:
Regarding the composition of Advisory Boards,

options_english:

made within three months from the date on

questions.question_english:

options_english: Any office or department of the Government

residential

questions.explanation_english:

questions.question_english:
Which landmark Supreme Court judgment
famously clarified that upon the abolition of
contract labour under Section 10 of the Contract
Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970,
there is no automatic absorption of the contract
workers into the principal employer’s regular
workforce?
options_english:
Air India Statutory Corporation and Others
v. United Labour Union and Others

Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage
Board v. A. Rajappa and Others

Steel Authority of India Ltd. (SAIL) v.
National Union Waterfront Workers

Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India concerning
fundamental constitutional rights
questions.explanation_english:
Steel Authority of India Ltd. (SAIL) v.
National Union Waterfront Workers
The Constitution Bench in SAIL (2001) overruled
Air India, clarifying that prohibiting contract
labour under Section 10 does not automatically
result in direct absorption of contract workers by
the Principal Employer, leaving adjudication of
absorption disputes to industrial tribunals.
questions.explanation_hindi: SAIL बनाम नेशनल यूनियन वॉटरफ्रंट वर्कर्स फैसले ने स्पष्ट किया कि ठेका श्रम के उन्मूलन से स्वतः नियमितीकरण नहीं होता।
key_facts:
Correct option (English): Steel Authority of India Ltd. (SAIL) v.
National Union Waterfront Workers
